title: The volume of my alarm is not loud enough.
body:
You can adjust the volume of your alarm but you must do so in two places. You may also consider downloading a more effective alarm sound from a website like ‘Zedge.’

First, adjust the volume in your iPhone’s Settings > Sounds & Haptics > Ringtone and Alerts. This determines the volume of the alarm while your iPhone is locked.

Next, adjust the volume in the Lasso App’s Settings > Volume. This determines the volume of the alarm after you’ve unlocked your iPhone. Try to match both for a seamless transition.

If your alarm is still too quiet after this, please reach out to us using the button below. Another setting could be affecting your volume.
